models.previewReview: Whole European badger with realistic grizzled fur, short limbs and facial stripes, mounted on a support plinth. Taxidermy face and scan-clumped paws need reshaping; support removal, ventral closure, retopology, fur rebake, rig and eight clips required.

models.name: Stout Badger Standing Realistic
models.author: Pigcraft
models.description: A realistic 3D model of a stout, compact badger. It has short gray-brown fur with distinct black facial stripes, strong paws, and a short, bushy tail. The badger stands on all fours, with its head slightly tilted forward and broad, sturdy shoulders. Its compact build and detailed anatomy make it perfect for wildlife, nature, or character projects.
